hints.name: Reuse existing shell primitives
hints.description: When adapting this visual language to the product, reuse existing sidebar, button, avatar, badge and card primitives before creating new ones.
hints.recommendation: Map the reference roles to existing project components first; only create a new shared component when no compatible abstraction exists.
hints.reason: Prevents a screenshot reference from creating a parallel component library.

when: Existing component cannot satisfy an approved design contract.
mustReport: Which shared abstraction is proposed instead.

hints.name: Run layout rhythm audit
hints.description: Treat hierarchy spacing, repeated card gaps and edge alignment as a dedicated audit pass.
hints.recommendation: Audit token compliance, repeated-gap outliers, hierarchy rhythm, alignment consistency and density before handoff.
hints.reason: The reference relies heavily on restrained, repeated spacing to create hierarchy.

when: An approved product constraint intentionally breaks the reference rhythm.
mustReport: The intentional exception and affected scope.
